note: Machine-readable transcript queue AND the discovery seen-set. Maintained by the watch-creators skill (agents). videos[] = queued for transcript fetch (append in-scope videos whose transcript could not be read this run; remove ONLY after distilled or verified-skipped), drained by the deterministic src/fetch-transcripts.mjs step when TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY is configured (25/run cap, free-tier budget). skipped[] = transcript WAS read and yielded nothing (durable, costs a fetch to establish). triaged[] = rejected from title + RSS description with NO transcript fetched (cheaper, reversible — reopen only with a positive reason and say so in the log). The three lanes are mutually exclusive and none may contain a video cited by a take or metaNote. triagedFrom is the discovery floor: videos published before it are out of scope for the nightly poll because the 2026-07 seeding pass already harvested that backlog (184 of the takes/metaNotes on file are dated before it, citing 118 distinct videos) — without the floor every run re-derived ~178 old feed entries as unseen. Seeded 2026-07-17 from the watch-creators log; triaged[] added 2026-08-05.
